releaseNotes:
Fixed: paid receipts could still show UNPAID. A receipt's amount due includes any balance carried into the visit, and settlement was comparing money against that full figure instead of what the receipt itself charged - so a receipt written while the customer already owed something could never reach PAID. Six receipts in the live ledger were in that state and have been corrected automatically on first launch. Genuinely outstanding receipts are untouched.

Fixed: deleting a receipt did not change the customer's balance. Every payment stores the balance it was computed against, so removing one left every later payment carrying figures that still included the deleted money. Deleting now rebuilds the customer's figures from the payments that remain, after its backup.

New: the payment form now asks what kind of visit it is.

   Collect payment    bill this month and record what you took
   Unpaid visit       bill this month, nothing collected
   Old balance only   collect arrears without billing a new month

You no longer have to enter a fake price, or a fake zero, to record an unpaid visit or to settle an old balance. Settling arrears no longer bills a second month by accident.

Everything from 4.2 and 4.3 is included: balance reconciliation from the office to the phone, the customer identity fix, the History page, and the sync retry protections.
